summary:
Police say a 16-year-old assailant killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, before an armed bystander killed him. The children were aged 5, 8 and 11. In Pakistan, a school roof collapsed in Peshawar, killing at least 33 pupils and a teacher, according to hospital officials; another report put the toll at 34 children. Police say the roof fell through three classrooms and children were buried under debris.

Donald Trump called Ukraine’s resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace” in an interview with Newsmax, and said Volodymyr Zelensky was “more difficult to deal with than Putin.” Zelensky said a brief energy truce, which Moscow had spurned, was over, and Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia’s Ryazan region early Thursday. Zelensky also sought European backing ahead of a meeting of EU leaders in Brussels.

Houthi missiles struck the Maashiq presidential palace in Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said. Yemen’s information minister said the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt. In the Black Sea, two drone attacks on ships left seven people missing off Romania, and two chemical tankers caught fire in Romanian territorial waters after Russian drones were sighted in Romanian airspace.

headlines.title: Shooting at Oregon elementary school kills four, including three children
headlines.summary: Police say a 16-year-old assailant killed three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, before an armed bystander shot and killed him. The children were aged 5, 8 and 11.

headlines.title: Roof collapse at Pakistani school kills at least 33 pupils
headlines.summary: A school roof collapsed in Peshawar, Pakistan, killing at least 33 pupils and a teacher, according to hospital officials, while another report put the toll at 34 children. Police say the roof crashed through three classrooms and children were buried under debris.

headlines.title: Trump calls Ukraine’s refinery strikes a disgrace
headlines.summary: Donald Trump called Ukraine’s resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace” in a Newsmax interview. Zelensky said a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over, and Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia’s Ryazan region early Thursday.

headlines.title: Houthi missiles hit Aden presidential palace, killing five
headlines.summary: Houthi missiles struck the Maashiq presidential palace in Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said. Yemen’s information minister said the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt.

headlines.title: Seven missing after drone attacks on ships off Romania
headlines.summary: Romania reported seven people missing after two drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea. Two chemical tankers caught fire in Romanian territorial waters after Russian drones were sighted in Romanian airspace.

headlines.title: Houthi attacks lead to postponed sporting events in Saudi Arabia
headlines.summary: Several major sporting events in Saudi Arabia have been cancelled or postponed after repeated Houthi attacks on the kingdom’s airports and infrastructure. The Asian Tour postponed the Saudi Invitational golf, while organisers say the Asian Cup in January is still on.

headlines.title: Second Ebola case confirmed in Kenya
headlines.summary: A second person has tested positive for the Bundibugyo virus in Kenya, the World Health Organization’s representative in the country said Thursday. The WHO said it continues to support Kenya’s efforts to contain Ebola.

headlines.title: Minibus crashes into stationary train at Channel Tunnel entrance
headlines.summary: A minibus carrying truck drivers hit a stationary shuttle train near Calais on Thursday evening, injuring 19 people and suspending services for 90 minutes. Two were hospitalised with serious injuries, but the local prefect said five were severely injured.
